title: GTA 6 Is Out In 1 Week - Trailer 2 Details You Missed
description:
GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Here's what you might have missed in Trailer 2.
Footage: Grand Theft Auto VI Trailer 2 (c) Rockstar Games.

#gta6 #gtavi #gta #shorts

scenes.narration: GTA 6 launches in one week, so here's what you missed in Trailer 2.
Jason Duval picks up Lucia Caminos the moment she walks out of prison.
And plenty of fans think Lucia is the one calling the shots.
Rockstar named the regions too. Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga.
Listen closely and you'll hear someone shout, Vice City, baby!
Some fans even spotted a guy who looks a lot like Phil Cassidy. That one is unconfirmed.
The song is Hot Together by the Pointer Sisters. Trailer 1 used Tom Petty's Love Is a Long Road.
GTA 6 hits PS5 and Xbox Series X and S on November 19. Follow for launch week coverage.
